title: Sweep simulation cost
statement: For natural numbers $k,n$ and Boolean flags $left,right$, define the cost to be $$(1+n k)+(1+\operatorname{nat}(right)(k+1))+(n+\operatorname{nat}(right))k+(1+\operatorname{nat}(left)(k+1)),$$ where each Boolean is identified with its natural-number value $0$ or $1$.
